snippet.title: Trenchblocks - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Trenchblocks is a charming yet violent voxel shooter that turns the battlefield into a playground of digging, building, and destruction. In frantic Capture the Flag matches you can construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases using fully destructible terrain to outsmart opponents.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4217940?curator_clanid=46009612
